title: tblW auto with uniform tcW keeps the tcW; a column grows to its bare widest word, where a space beside a middle dot or before a colon and a "/" never break and a hyphen does
source: probe build.py (A4 9026-twip column, Calibri 11, cell margins 108), Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf vertical rules; the harness measures with the 0.52em heuristic, so the tolerances cover heuristic-vs-Calibri advance drift while keeping the glued and broken cases apart

cases.note: uniform 1504 x 6 with wrapped sentences is drawn as declared (Word 1498-1508), no content re-autofit
1000 x 6 under 'Documento': that column grows to the word + 216 (Word 1268), the table stays under the column so nothing is reclaimed (heuristic 0.58em/char measures 1455)
'mmmm · mmmm' is one word: Word 90.5 pt = whole string + margins; the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
control 'mmmm mmmm': Word 46.6 pt = one 'mmmm' + margins; the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
'mmmm/mmmm' never breaks at the slash: Word 87.1 pt; the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
'mmmm-mmmm' breaks after the hyphen: Word 49.9 pt = 'mmmm-' + margins; the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
'mmmm : mmmm' keeps the space before the colon: Word 52.1 pt = 'mmmm :' + margins; the second column takes the rest of the 9026 column
